description: The plot illustrates loss ratio (in percent) as a function of compute measured in TFLOPs for five methods/variants. The x-axis is labeled “TFLOPs,” uses a logarithmic scale, and shows tick labels from 1e7 to 9e8 with labeled points at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis is labeled “Loss Ratio (%)” on a linear scale, ranging from 94 to 100 with integer tick marks. The purple “Vanilla” line uses triangle markers and stays essentially flat at about 100% across the full x-range. The orange “SepLLM (n=64)” line is solid with no visible markers and rises from about 98.3% at 1e7 to around 100% by roughly 2e8–3e8, with a visible local high around 4e8 slightly above 100%, then remains near 100% through 9e8. The blue “SepLLM (n=128)” line uses x-shaped markers and increases from about 97.0% at 1e7 to about 99.9–100% by around 2e8–3e8, then stays close to 100% with small fluctuations through 9e8. The green “SepLLM (n=64, H)” line uses diamond markers and climbs from about 97.5% at 1e7 to about 100% by around 2e8–4e8, shows a small peak slightly above 100% near about 6e8, and ends near 100% at 9e8. The red “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” line uses circular markers and increases from about 94.0% at 1e7 to about 99.0–99.1% by around 4e8, dips to roughly 98.5% near 5e8, returns to about 99.0% around 6e8–7e8, and finishes slightly below 99% (about 98.7–98.8%) at 9e8.
